messages:
marie: quick Q — debugging a customer report of high p99 TTFT on Dedicated. Where's the canonical place to pull TTFT (time-to-first-token) broken down by model/route/host? Also want tokens/sec and a couple Jaeger traces for slow requests so I can correlate. thanks!

alex: start with the "Redwood->Latency: TTFT" Grafana dash. Panels to look at: 
- 'TTFT p50/p95/p99 by model' (use the 'group by model' dropdown)
- 'TTFT heatmap by route+host'
- 'Tokens/sec (ingress)' panel for throughput patterns

PromQL snippets that we use on those panels:
```
# p99 TTFT per model over 5m
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_first_token_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route))

# tokens/sec per route
sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[1m])) by (route, model)
```

Link to the dash (internal): https://grafana.redwood.local/d/latency/ttft-overview (use the time picker to zoom to the incident window)

nate: for traces, filter Jaeger by `operation=first-token` and add tags `model`, `route`, `host`. example Jaeger link: https://jaeger.redwood.local/trace/{{traceID}} — when you click a trace, look for a long server span and the attached logs (request/response size + kernel selection).

jess: quick note on logs — if you need the raw request/response, use Kibana log query: `service:runtime AND route:"/v1/generate" AND trace_id: <traceID>` and set `@timestamp` to the incident window. We also roll up per-host `ttft_summary` every minute to speed lookups.

marie: awesome, any advice on which TTFT percentile is most informative for customer-facing latency? p95 vs p99?

alex: p95 is generally actionable for UX, p99 surfaces outliers that often point to kernel path or batching stalls. Start with p95 to see overall regressions, then jump to p99 for root-cause. Also compare tokens/sec concurrently — if tokens/sec spikes while p99 increases, it's likely scheduling/batching.

sam: if you want to tune alerts, the repo is infra/alerts/eng-runtime/ttft_alerts.yaml — default p99 alert is 2.5s for hosted, 3.5s for Dedicated. For this customer we raised it to 4s temporarily while we investigate. If you think it should be permanent, file a PR and @sam for review.

marie: can someone drop a quick Jaeger trace and a sample promql time-range? I'll attach to the support ticket.

obs-bot: dashboard "Redwood - Latency: TTFT" was refreshed (panels updated) :sparkles:

alex: I grabbed a couple traces from 1844999000-1845002000 — pinned them to the incident thread and added two sample queries (see pinned messages in the grafana dash). TraceIDs: `a3f4b2...` (p99 slow path, host gpu-12) and `c9d8e1...` (batch stall).

nate: FYI, common root-causes for p99 TTFT on Dedicated: kernel selection fallback, small batch drift (lots of single-request batches), or GC pauses in a worker process. When you post traces I can look for span tags like `kernel: fallback` or `batch_size: 1`.

jess: added a short runbook fragment to the runtime ops doc (docs/runtime/obs-runbooks.md) with quick links and the PromQL snippets above. If you want, I can copy a minimal checklist into the support ticket.

marie: perfect — please copy that into the ticket and I'll add the customer's traces. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sam: sounds good — I'll follow up on the alert thresholds after we confirm root cause.

marie: closing loop here once I attach traces and logs. If anyone has a minute to glance later, ping me.
